newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugo BB-Group to handle local banks' debts, claims.
newsitem.headline: Yugo BB-Group to handle local banks' debts, claims.

text.p: Bank members of the giant Yugoslav Beogradska banka system have agreed to form a special new bank for international payment and credit operations, Belgrade media reported Friday.
The new Beogradska Banka-Group (BB-Group) will handle most of international claims and liabilities of Yugoslav banks and companies, the daily Politika said.
Beogradska banka groups 20 out of 100 Yugoslav banks and services almost two thirds of all Serbian companies.
BB-Group will also take over credit transactions with other countries.

"The main task is to return financial vitality to the entire banking system, especially to the Beogradska banka group as soon as possible, relying primarily on its own potential," the bank's acting general manager Borka Vucic was quoted by the paper as saying.
BB-Group's founding assembly is scheduled for May.
The group's initial capital will include existing funds and reserves of the Beogradska banka system and its share in the founding capital of joint stock banks at home and abroad.

Member banks, authorised for international payments and credit operations, will pay $1 million each as the founding capital of the new banking giant, while other members of the group will contribute $500,000 each, Politika said.
BB-Group will also form a special bank rehabilitation agency to take over its members' debt and help their recovery. -- Beti Bilandzic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 222 4305
